channel.title: QuietHike — Figma Price Changes
channel.description: Every Figma pricing change QuietHike has caught and verified, and nothing else.

item.title: Figma's per-product pricing became per-seat, and monthly billing disappeared from Organization and Enterprise
item.description: The bigger story isn't the sticker price: it's that Organization and Enterprise no longer offer monthly billing at all going forward, only annual. Teams with fluctuating headcount lost a flexibility option that existed before the overhaul, and it's easy to miss unless you're pricing out a renewal. Per-seat pricing (as of Sep 2026) breaks down as: Professional: Full $16/mo, Dev $12/mo, Collab $3/mo; Organization: Full $55/mo, Dev $25/mo, Collab $5/mo; Enterprise: Full $90/mo, Dev $35/mo, Collab $5/mo. Figma Design itself can't be purchased separately; it's bundled into the Full seat alongside Dev Mode, FigJam, and Figma Slides.
